## BundlerErrors.MissingSignature class

Thrown when an action that requires an offchain signature is encoded before the signature has been attached.

**Signature:**

```typescript
class MissingSignature extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Example


```ts
import { BundlerErrors } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

if (error instanceof BundlerErrors.MissingSignature) {
  // Attach the missing permit or Permit2 signature, then encode again.
}
```
